fact: The Whole of Government National Digital Strategy was drafted after stakeholder workshops of 3-4 December 2024 and a validation workshop on 11 December 2024, carries a presidential message, an action plan with timelines and a costing chapter, and proposes an ICT Governing Board chaired by the President.
title: "Whole of Government" National Digital Strategy
publisher: Government of Liberia (Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications)
